Old names kept for rmoriedata 0.3.x

Source: R/compat_0_5.R
rmbl-compat.Rd

rmoriedata 0.3.x on CRAN calls eleven functions by their 0.5.x names. These wrappers keep that release installing and checking against rmoriebricklayer 1.0.0. Each one forwards to the function named in its body, translating the old argument names: cpssign(), cpsvrf(), pqckg(), signpubkey(), csha256(), cmn(), sha256file(), tojs(), fromjs(), blfetch() and wbsnpurl(). New code should call the new names directly; these wrappers go when every released rmoriedata uses them.

Usage

capsule_sign(
  message,
  key,
  scheme = NULL,
  context = NULL,
  deterministic = FALSE,
  prehash = "none",
  masked = getOption("rmoriebricklayer.masked", TRUE)
)

capsule_verify(message, signature, key, context = NULL, prehash = NULL)

pqc_keygen(height = 10L, sk_seed = NULL, pub_seed = NULL, sk_prf = NULL)

signing_public_key(key)

core_sha256(x)

core_mean(x)

sha256_file(path)

bricklayer_json_to_json(x, ...)

bricklayer_json_from_json(txt, ...)

bricklayer_fetch(url, dest, wayback = "", timeout = 120L)

wayback_snapshot_url(url, timestamp = NULL)

Arguments

message, signature

msg and sig of the new name.

key, scheme, prehash, masked

As in the new name.

context

ctx of the new name.

deterministic

determ of cpssign().

height

height of pqckg().

sk_seed

skseed of pqckg().

pub_seed

pubseed of pqckg().

sk_prf

skprf of pqckg().

x

x of csha256(), cmn() or tojs().

path

path of sha256file().

...

Passed through to tojs() or fromjs().

txt

txt of fromjs().

url, dest

As in blfetch() and wbsnpurl().

wayback, timeout

wb and tmout of blfetch().

timestamp

ts of wbsnpurl().

Value

What the forwarded function returns.

Examples

# keep this example's
op <- options(rmoriebricklayer.xmssidxfile = tempfile())
# one-time index record out of your configuration directory
k <- pqc_keygen(height = 2)
s <- capsule_sign(core_sha256("manifest"), k)
capsule_verify(core_sha256("manifest"), s, signing_public_key(k))
#> [1] TRUE
options(op)
